verdict: Paid campaigns went dark four days; 95 leads this period won't hold without them.
narrative: You received 95 leads at a cost of $5.23 per lead over the last 28 days, with the strongest efficiency gains landing in the first three weeks before Meta delivery stopped completely on September 24. Four consecutive days of zero spend and zero leads confirmed this as a delivery collapse, not a one-day anomaly — and site traffic fell by roughly 77% in that same window, showing how dependent your current volume is on paid traffic running. We have identified the delivery gap and are working to restore Meta campaigns immediately. Several planned channels — including Google Search, local service ads, and nurture sequences — are also being brought online now, which will reduce your dependence on any single channel going forward.
